# Incapacitated [Condition]

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md) > [Conditions](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#IncapacitatedCondition)*

While you have the Incapacitated condition, you experience the following effects.

***Inactive.*** You can't take any [action](../Combat/Actions/Action.md), [Bonus Action](../Combat/Actions/Bonus-Action.md), or [Reaction](../Combat/Actions/Reaction.md).

***No Concentration.*** Your [Concentration](../Spells-and-Magic/Concentration.md) is broken.

***Speechless.*** You can't speak.

***Surprised.*** If you're Incapacitated when you roll [Initiative](../Combat/Stats/Initiative.md), you have [Disadvantage](../D20-Tests/Disadvantage.md) on the roll.
